text: Is GSE309890 the same thing as GDS309890?

The GEO accession GSE309890 and GDS309890 are not the same thing. GSE309890 is a GEO Series record (entry type: GSE), while GDS309890 is a GEO DataSet record (entry type: GDS). They have different UID identifiers and FTP directories. The GSE is a series of related experiments, whereas the GDS is a curated data collection associated with that series.

- GSE309890: [NCBI GEO Series](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE309890)
- GDS309890: [NCBI GEO DataSet](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GDS309890)
